name: manual_a89e26
claim: To make a GossipBus.emit() atomic with another SQLite mutation (e.g. an exclusive-claim row insert/delete), use bus.transaction() to get a shared connection, bus.emit_within(db, event_type, payload) to insert the event without committing, commit once yourself, then bus.schedule_embed(row_id, safe_payload) afterward — never embed before the caller's own commit succeeds, since pre-commit data might still roll back.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 4679555600 flagged scripts/agent_coordination.py:140 as a Heavy-lift 'commit the claim row and task event atomically' gap — a crash between the two separate commits (_try_atomic_claim then a separate bus.emit()) could leave a claim row with no corresponding event, or vice versa for release. Verified atomic via an injected-failure test that proves rollback, not just a happy-path test.
